image_prompt: Monsieur Laurent, a cyberpunk anime interpretation of a middle-aged Calvinist schoolmaster. Lean, austere frame with sharp angular features and a narrow face lined with intellectual rigor. He wears a high-collared black coat with geometric cyberpunk elements—neon blue circuit-pattern trim along the edges and shoulders, blending 17th-century Calvinist austerity with futuristic technology. His hair is dark gray, slicked back severely, with faint luminescent streaks running through it. His eyes are sharp and penetrating behind thin wire-framed glasses with subtle holographic displays on the lenses. His expression is one of detached melancholy—a man of rigid principle caught between duty and quiet intellectual awakening. His hands are long-fingered and precise, suggesting years of calligraphy instruction. Around his wrists are minimal tech-bands emitting faint bioluminescent light. His overall appearance combines Prussian formality with cyberpunk aesthetic: dignified yet unsettling, scholarly yet haunted by technological determinism.
